title: More Discs
description: A mod that adds badbunny and other artists songs so you can play them in your jukebox in minecraft
body:
# More Discs

## Bring the Beats to Your Blocks.

Tired of the same old music in Minecraft? **More Discs** adds the biggest hits from the global superstar, Bad Bunny, right into your game. Start building, exploring, and fighting mobs with a better soundtrack.

## Current Features

- **DTMF Album Added:** The full tracklist from Bad Bunny’s DTMF is available as **new, collectible Music Discs.**
- **Disc Selector Block:** A simple, new block that functions as an advanced Jukebox and **is necessary for crafting the discs**. It allows you to place your discs inside and use the interface to **select the exact song you want to hear**.

## Crafting

### Disc Selector
- This block is essential for playing and crafting your new music.
- **Recipe**: The recipe is **shapeless** and requires:
  - 1x **Jukebox**
  - 1x **Lever**
  - 1x **Empty Disc**
  
### Creating Music Discs

The new music discs are created using the **Disc Selector** block:
1. **Craft the Empty Disc**: First, you will need an Empty Disc.
>   ![Crafting recipie for the empty disc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17d65f9dd8f668904dbd354dc096d9204af142ed_0.webp)
2. **Select the Album**: Insert the Empty Disc into the Disc Selector. Use the controls to set the Album Number to 8 (DTMF = 8). This will transform the Empty Disc into the DTMF Album Disc.
3. **Select the Song**: Take the new DTMF Album Disc and insert it back into the Disc Selector. Use the interface to move the slider to the Song Number that corresponds to the track you want to create. This final step yields the playable individual Music Disc.

**Note**: This mod is a fan project and **is not officially endorsed by or affiliated with Bad Bunny or his management/labels.**

Download **More Discs** now and turn up the volume on your Minecraft experience.
